text_block_list.text: One day, as I happened to pass by the field—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, I-I'm sorry! I thought you were the person I was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I told you before, right? About the "older girl" at the field whom I admire.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Whenever I'm here, I can't help but hope that I might run into her.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But coincidences don't happen very easily, do they? I really hope I can meet her someday...
choice_data_list: Why don't we try looking for her together?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: There was morning mist that day, so I couldn't see her face clearly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I'm pretty sure she was a mature "older girl," so...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmm. An "older girl" doing farmwork at the crack of dawn, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, one thing's for sure: it definitely wasn't me. I've got my hands full with dorm head duties, so I don't really have time to tend a field.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I see... I thought it might be you, Hishiama-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Because you're always looking out for all of us behind the scenes, Hishiama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Aw, cut it out, you're making me blush. Well, I'll ask around to see if anyone comes to mind!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Waking up early isn't really my thing...
Plus, I can't be getting sunburned, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So it wasn't me, but—if you're having trouble, want me to help you look?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, it's alright! It was just a thought.
...Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ............The field? Me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry! It was just a mistake on my part!
In the end, after spending the entire day searching, we couldn't find the "older girl."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I guess without knowing her face, finding her really is difficult, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But after searching properly, I actually feel refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. Of course, it's a shame that I couldn't meet that "older girl."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Even so, I realized that I can still aim to be like her!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: While searching, I thought a lot about her to try and remember what she was like.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But the more I thought about it, the more I realized that it wasn't her appearance that I admired. That's how it felt—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Because what I want to become is a cool "older girl" who quietly does what needs to be done even when nobody is watching.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So even if I don't know her face, I can still work hard just like that "older girl"!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Besides, if I keep working hard like this, when I finally do get to meet that "older girl" someday—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll be able to hold my head high when I talk to her. That's what made me realize it!

Nishino Flower declared this with absolute clarity.
Her demeanor and bright positivity felt remarkably dependable.
